content: boto3 1.44.5 works with Cloudflare R2 S3 API using endpoint https://<ACCOUNT_ID>.r2.cloudflarestorage.com and region_name auto. R2 implements PutObject, GetObject, DeleteObject, multipart create/upload_part/complete/abort and presigned URLs. R2 rejects FULL_OBJECT checksums and AWS SDK default CRC32 headers; set Config(request_checksum_calculation=when_required, response_checksum_validation=when_required) and compute own SHA-256 with hashlib.
